narrative.details:
Chapter III was my favorite.  It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle.  And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!

Looks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter.  Those pages are out there somewhere. . .
narrative.objectives: Bring pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 of Nesingwary's The Green Hills of Stranglethorn to Barnil Stonepot in order to complete Chapter III.
narrative.offerRewardText: Phew! Good work, adventurer. Chapter III is now back together in one piece!
narrative.requestItemsText: Any luck with pages 18, 20, 21 or 24?  Those are the only ones we need to piece together Chapter III.
